limits: All population restrictions are demographic sensitivities, not improved clinical validation or age matching.
Bulk, fibroblast-only and partial captured-cell RNA mixtures remain distinct estimands; 386 excluded captured cells have unknown RNA, and capture fractions are not intact tissue fractions.
Source-specific covariates are not a shared batch correction or causal identification; older male coverage remains inadequate.
Relative log1p(CPM), correlated genes and observational donor contrasts cannot establish intrinsic aging, a biological-age estimate, rejuvenation or functional repair.
Matched-donor bulk versus cell-resolved measurements are still missing; cohort, site, ascertainment and assay differences remain unresolved.
